mapper.select: SELECT id, event_version, user_id, store_name, phone, business_registration_number, business_verification_id, operation_status, address, address_detail, industry_type, minimum_order_amount, open_time, close_time, deletion_request_id, deletion_requested_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM stores WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, event_version, user_id, store_name, phone, business_registration_number, business_verification_id, operation_status, address, address_detail, industry_type, minimum_order_amount, open_time, close_time, deletion_request_id, deletion_requested_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM stores WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stores ( user_id, store_name, phone, business_registration_number, business_verification_id, operation_status, address, address_detail, industry_type, minimum_order_amount, open_time, close_time, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{storeName}, #{phone}, #{businessRegistrationNumber}, #{businessVerificationId}, #{operationStatus}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{industryType}, #{minimumOrderAmount}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, NOW(6), NOW(6) )
mapper.update:
UPDATE stores
store_name = #{storeName}, phone = #{phone}, operation_status = #{operationStatus}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, industry_type = #{industryType}, minimum_order_amount = #{minimumOrderAmount}, open_time = #{openTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, event_version = event_version + 1, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
